explanation: Kinematics (W=1.6 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0.5, phi*=90 deg) are physically valid for eta electroproduction ep -> e'p eta: W is above the eta-p threshold (m_p+m_eta = 1.486 GeV), and at the standard CLAS12 beam momentum of 6.53 GeV this (W,Q2) point requires a scattered-electron angle of ~9.9 deg with E'~5.1 GeV, which is kinematically accessible (positive E', sin^2(theta/2) < 1) and within the EtaMAID-2023 table coverage (Q2: 0-5 GeV^2, W: 1.486-6 GeV) used by the eta configuration of exclurad. No compiler is available in this environment, so the code could not be built or executed; the deliverable is the EXCLURAD input file, generated with the standard CLAS12 settings documented in eta/README.md and eta/examples/README.md: model=3 (EtaMAID/maid2000), rc_mode=0 (full O(alpha) RC), bmom=6.53 GeV, tmom=0.0, lepton=1 (electron), ivec=1 (detected recoil proton), vcut=0.166 GeV^2 (CLAS12 eta-analysis inelasticity cut). Running './build/exclurad.exe < input_eta_W1.6_Q2_1.0.dat' from the eta/ directory (after building with make or scons) will produce radcor.dat and related output files containing the radiative correction factor delta = sigma_obs/sigma_0 at this kinematic point.
